lines.en: Pore slowly, like dead leaves.
Swing sword at spirits, flash of cold light.
Sharp eyes, locking onto targets.

lines.zh: 我咳了一声，刀却没有晃。
lines.en: I cough once, but the blade does not waver.

lines.zh: 脚步沉重，每一步都沉重。
lines.en: Heavy footsteps, each step heavy.

lines.zh: 挥舞着剑，如同秋风扫落叶。
lines.en: Wielding sword, like autumn wind sweeping leaves.
Coldness from the sword tip spreads.

lines.zh: 眼中燃烧着日之呼吸的火焰。
lines.en: Eyes burning with solar breathing fire.

lines.zh: 脚步声回荡在荒凉之地。
lines.en: Footsteps echo in the desolate place.
Coldness surrounds the body.

lines.zh: 老剑客一步一顿，握着刀。
lines.en: The old swordsman walks haltingly, sword in hand.

lines.zh: 刀鞘轻碰腰侧，随步作响。
lines.en: The sheath taps his hip with each step.
Half-closed eyes, waiting for the opportunity.
Withered hands gently sway.
Breathing slowly, like a zombie.
Empty eyes, staring into the distance.
Lean body slightly trembling.
Dull eyes, gazing ahead.

lines.zh: 沉默寡言，只在必要时说话。
lines.en: Silent, speaking only when necessary.
Robe swaying slightly in the wind.
Silently wandering in the shadows.
Pale face, like death itself.

lines.zh: 我抬起眼，你动一下试试。
lines.en: I raise my eyes; try to move.

lines.zh: 察觉玩家，立即准备攻击。
lines.en: Noticing the player, readying an attack.

lines.zh: 目光闪烁，寻找攻击机会。
lines.en: Eyes flickering, seeking an attack opportunity.
Sun Breathing; age changes nothing.
Noticing the player, starting to approach.
Steadfast eyes, not looking away.
Sharp eyes, tightly focusing on the player.

lines.zh: 盯紧玩家，随时准备出手。
lines.en: Fixing on the player, ready to act.
Eyes like swords, piercing the player.

lines.zh: 老花眼也不耽误我看你。
lines.en: Old eyes still do not miss you.
Weak body, decaying health
Worn strength, deteriorating health
Withered soul, fading health
Decaying body, unbearable pain
Rattling bones, pain to the bone
Weak and faint, struggling to breathe
Exhausted, barely alive
Breath weak, hanging by a thread
Withered body, weakening every moment
Tireless, on the brink of death
Draw near, feel my blade's wrath!
Take a fragment of my soul!
Why not feed on me?
Under the sun wheel, death comes first.
My power comes from the darkness!

lines.zh: 我不吃你的东西，我只闻刀。
lines.en: I eat none of it; I only scent the blade.
Souls at rest, finally rest!
Eat me, or be eaten!
In darkness, I am king!

lines.zh: 我不吃你的食物，我只斩鬼。
lines.en: I want no food of yours. I only cut demons.

lines.zh: 别碰我！我比你想象的更强！
lines.en: Touch me not! I'm stronger than you think!
An old man's steps are still steady.
My armor withstands all!
Step back, or you'll regret it!

lines.zh: 日之呼吸的余烬还在烧。
lines.en: The embers of sun breathing still burn.

lines.zh: 你太弱了，我根本不需要攻击！
lines.en: You're too weak, I don't need to attack!

lines.zh: 别想靠近我，我会杀死你！
lines.en: Don't get close, I'll kill you!
My presence terrifies you!

lines.zh: 你只是我剑下的一个名字！
lines.en: You're just another name on my sword!
I won't die easily!
Fellow, let us meet our end together!

lines.zh: 我这把年纪，只想有人收刀。
lines.en: At my age, I only wish someone to sheathe the blade.
You're the perfect partner!
Our souls shall unite!

lines.zh: 老了，也想有人陪到日落。
lines.en: Old now, and still wanting company till dusk.
Fellow, share this undead kiss!
Be with me, feel the darkness!

lines.zh: 我们的灵魂将永恒在一起！
lines.en: Our souls will be together forever!
You'll be immortal with me!

lines.zh: 同类，我们一同前往彼岸！
lines.en: Fellow, let's go to the beyond together!

lines.zh: 干枯的藤蔓缠绕我残躯。
lines.en: Withered vines cling to my decayed form.
My strength follows me like a shadow.

lines.zh: 阴冷的月光下，我更显恐怖。
lines.en: In the cold light of the moon, I am more terrifying.

lines.zh: 寻找你的灵魂，继国缘壹。
lines.en: Seek your soul, Yoriichi Tsugikuni.
Hunger fills my eyes, fixating on you.
Rotting armor shields me.

lines.zh: 日之呼吸的剑技，即将施展。
lines.en: The sword techniques of Day Breath are about to be unleashed.
I will consume your life.

lines.zh: 在这阴暗之地，我的力量无处不在。
lines.en: In this dark place, my strength is omnipresent.

lines.zh: 这把刀陪我斩过太多恶鬼。
lines.en: This blade has cut too many demons with me.
You cannot escape, evil ghost.

lines.zh: 你脖颈上的线，我看得清。
lines.en: I can see the line along your neck.

lines.zh: 感知到你的存在，我更强大。
lines.en: Feeling your presence, I grow stronger.
The scent of prey is so close.

lines.zh: 我的气息将引导你走向终结。
lines.en: My presence will guide you to your end.
You cannot escape my sight.
Feel the fear I instill.
Devour you and taste death.
Your pain nourishes me.

lines.zh: 你离死亡只有一步之遥。
lines.en: You are one step from death.

lines.zh: 恶鬼的气味，从不难闻错。
lines.en: A demon's stench is never mistaken.
Old hands, yet the grip stays steady.

lines.zh: 你身上有血的味道，不是人血。
lines.en: You smell of blood, and not human blood.

lines.zh: 我这一生只认一个目标。
lines.en: In this life I have only ever had one aim.
Did you catch that flash of the blade?
My sun blade is not dull yet.
The prey is within my grasp.
Old, but Sun Breathing remains.
The sword points to your soul.
Sun Breathing, one move left.
Death will end your pain.
My breath slows, and the blade arrives.
You will taste death.
End your life.
The death sword is about to fall.
My breathing slows, and the blade rises.
You are inside my circle.
Sun Breathing, first form.
My knees shake. The blade does not.
I saw your strike before you made it.
The edge travels along the side of your neck.
Age cannot take this eyesight from me.
Do not rush to flee. Stand still.
I have practiced this cut for seventy years.
When you die, you will remember this light.
Hisss, coldness seeps out!
The sword strikes like lightning, cutting through all!
A single sword slash through myriad foes, its sharpness evident!
Evil spirits, your doom draws near!
Frosty sword aura, freezing everything!
Sword tip trembling, death nears!
Solar Breath, sword technique awakened!
Cut through darkness, light returns!
Evil spirits, you shall meet the sword!
Multiple sword shadows, death's announcement!
A round dance cut severs your arm!
The blade sweeps up from the ground!
A slanted flash, and your blood flies!
I step in, and the blade has passed your neck.
A sun halo turns along the blade!
Firelight runs along the edge!
The blade falls; your shadow breaks first.
This cut leaves no way back.
Gates of the underworld open!
Evil spirits gather, battle commences!
Underworld summon, Yoriichi Tsugikuni appears!
Darkness's breath, about to awaken!
By the River Styx, waiting for you!
Ghostly flames flicker, I am awakened!
King of the underworld, appearing here!
Evil spirits' souls, merge with the sword!
Master of the underworld, none may invade!
Darkness's heart, I guard here!

lines.zh: 破晓时分，老剑客握刀而立。
lines.en: At daybreak the old swordsman stands with his blade.
I followed the demon aura to this place.
I have lived too long; only this blade is left.
Where demons gather, I will be there.
Burning flames, searing pain
Fell to abyss, bones shattered
Drowned, powerless
Explosion remnants, torn flesh
Arrow pierced, barely alive
Magic strike, barely alive
Starving, weak and faint
Lightning struck, paralyzed
Void devoured, soul gone
